QuestInfo.name: [Karote] Rumblings of the Tower
QuestInfo.0:
Grandis' integration with Maple World means that the High Flora are a threat to both worlds now.
#bNeinheart#k has called a meeting with the #bChief Knights#k to discuss information and options. Join the meeting and see what can be done.
QuestInfo.1: The Chief Knights have shared intel from all across Maple World.
QuestInfo.2:
The Chief Knights have reported sightings of a legendary tower, #bKarote#k.
Go to #bHotel Arcus#k and investigate the story of the tower.
